label: Ответить
description: A 10-sentence conjugation card for ответить (to answer).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective future, first-person. 'Отвечу' is the simple future of the perfective ответить; the т of the stem mutates to ч in the 1sg. The imperfective partner is отвечать.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, second-person. 'Ответишь' shows the -ишь ending with the stem т restored after the 1sg mutation. 'На вопрос' is the standard accusative target of an answer.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, third-person. 'Ответит' is the -ит form of ответить, naming a single completed reply. 'Скоро' marks the near future.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, first-person plural. 'Ответим' carries the -им ending of ответить. 'Всем гостям' is a dative recipient and 'обязательно' adds firm intent.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, polite or plural. 'Ответите' trains the -ите form of ответить. 'Мне честно' frames a direct, natural request.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, third-person plural. 'Ответят' closes the person ladder with the -ят ending of ответить. 'Через несколько минут' fixes the completed moment.

missions.phrase: Вчера он сразу ответил на звонок.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective past, masculine. 'Ответил' is the completed masculine past of ответить with the -л suffix. 'Сразу' stresses that the single reply happened at once.

missions.phrase: Она спокойно ответила на все вопросы.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective past, feminine. 'Ответила' adds the feminine -ла ending of ответить. 'На все вопросы' shows the act completed in full.
Strategic focus: Perfective past, plural. 'Ответили' is the plural -ли past of ответить. 'Учителю' is the dative listener; contrast this single completed act with imperfective отвечать.
Strategic focus: Perfective imperative, singular. 'Ответь' is the command form of ответить. 'Пожалуйста' and 'прямо сейчас' make a complete, urgent appeal to one listener.
